repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

repos.description: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
repos.summary_zh: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是跨平台本地网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码智能体的模型配置。支持多供应商切换与配额耗尽自动故障转移，提供菜单栏、TUI、Web UI 及 CLI 界面，实现任意智能体与任意模型的灵活组合。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a cross-platform local gateway that centralizes model configuration for multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It supports multi-provider switching, automatic failover when quotas are exhausted, and provides menu bar, TUI, Web UI, and CLI interfaces. Developers can flexibly pair any agent with any model across macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, and Termux environments. One unified app manages all agent configs, provider keys, and routing rules, ensuring seamless model switching without manual intervention or downtime.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

repos.description: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS
repos.summary_zh: UTM 是一款基于 QEMU 的 iOS 和 macOS 全系统虚拟化工具，支持 x86_64、ARM64、RISC-V 等 30 多种处理器架构。它提供 JIT 加速版本和无需越狱的 SE 解释器版本，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上运行 Windows、Linux 等操作系统。利用 Hypervisor 和 Virtualization 框架实现硬件加速，是移动设备和桌面端的强大虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UTM is a full-featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS, built on QEMU. It supports 30+ processor architectures including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V, enabling users to run Windows, Linux, and other operating systems on iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The platform offers JIT-based acceleration for optimal performance and a special SE (Slow Edition) using threaded interpretation that requires no jailbreak. With native frontends leveraging latest Apple APIs and hardware acceleration via Hypervisor.framework and Virtualization.framework, UTM delivers a powerful cross-platform virtualization solution for both mobile and desktop environments.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过Docker容器化技术结合KVM硬件加速，在非Apple硬件上实现macOS虚拟化。提供Web管理界面，支持macOS 11-15版本自动部署与灵活资源配置（存储/CPU/内存）。适用于iOS/macOS应用开发测试、CI/CD流水线及跨平台开发环境，为开发者提供无需Apple硬件的macOS虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project enables macOS virtualization on non-Apple hardware through Docker containerization with KVM hardware acceleration. It features web-based management, automated deployment of macOS versions 11-15 (Big Sur to Sequoia), and flexible configuration of storage, CPU, and RAM resources. Supporting Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces deployment, it is ideal for iOS/macOS app development testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-platform development environments, providing developers with a convenient, production-ready macOS virtualization solution without Apple hardware requirements.

repos.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
repos.summary_zh: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

repos.description: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
repos.summary_zh: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
repos.summary_en: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

repos.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
repos.summary_zh: 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》iOS/macOS 兼容层，将 Switch 版游戏原生移植至 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。基于 aarch64 原生执行与 Metal 图形重实现，支持术士君临扩展、完整触控操作、60fps 流畅运行，用户自备游戏文件即可离线畅玩。
repos.summary_en: Open-source iOS/macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock. Runs the Switch build natively on Apple devices via aarch64 execution and Metal graphics reimplementation, with full touch controls and 60 fps.

repos.description: In-place tweak injection with insert_dylib and ChOma.
repos.summary_zh: TrollFools 是一款专为 TrollStore 设计的轻量级 tweak 注入工具，利用 insert_dylib 和 ChOma 实现 Mach-O 二进制文件的原地动态库注入。支持 iOS 14-17 系统应用及 App Store 应用的修改，无论是解密还是加密状态。采用 SwiftUI 开发，界面现代且体积小巧，旨在替代有缺陷的 optool，为越狱社区提供高效稳定的 tweak 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: TrollFools is a lightweight tweak injection tool specifically designed for TrollStore ecosystem, leveraging insert_dylib and ChOma to perform in-place dynamic library injection directly into Mach-O binaries. It supports iOS 14-17, capable of modifying removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps, and even encrypted App Store apps with bare dynamic libraries. Written entirely in SwiftUI, it delivers a modern user interface while maintaining a small package size. The project aims to replace the problematic optool by compiling a statically linked install_name_tool, providing the jailbreak community with a more reliable and efficient solution for tweak deployment.

repos.description: A translation-based Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
repos.summary_zh: Stela 是面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层，通过 UEFI 启动，集成 arm64-to-x86-64 翻译器（覆盖 3000+ 指令）、NVIDIA Metal 驱动（AIR 转 NIR）和 Apple silicon 硬件模型，使 macOS 27 能在 Intel/AMD 机器上运行。目前开发中，速度较慢。
repos.summary_en: Stela is a general-purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It boots via UEFI, integrating an arm64-to-x86-64 translator (covering 3000+ instructions), a Metal driver for NVIDIA GPUs (AIR to NIR), and an Apple silicon hardware model, enabling macOS 27 to run on Intel/AMD machines. Currently in development, it is slow.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.description: A tiny hand on a stick that points at things on your Mac screen.
repos.summary_zh: TinyHand 是一款 macOS 屏幕指针工具，在屏幕上显示一只小手或激光点，用于演示、录屏或远程指导时精准指向内容。支持点击、拖动画线、添加箭头、36种手势及声音反馈，可通过菜单栏快捷键或 tinyhand:// URL 自动化控制，轻量且开源。
repos.summary_en: TinyHand is a macOS on-screen pointer tool that displays a tiny hand or laser dot to precisely point at content during demos, recordings, or remote guidance. It supports clicking, drag-drawing, arrowheads, 36 hand styles, and tap sounds, controllable via menu bar shortcuts or tinyhand:// URLs. Lightweight and open-source.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.description: A playground for live Metal shaders on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch. Save any shader as a wallpaper.
